mn65:29.1: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena pubbe appatarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ bahutarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahiṃsu
mn65:29.2: ko pana bhante hetu ko paccayo yenetarahi bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni ahesuṃ appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahantīti.
mn65:30.1: evañhetaṃ bhaddāli hoti sattesu hāyamānesu saddhamme antaradhāyamāne bahutarāni ceva sikkhāpadāni honti appatarā ca bhikkhū aññāya saṇṭhahanti.
mn65:30.2: na tāva bhaddāli satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti yāva na idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti.
mn65:30.3: yato ca kho bhaddāli idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:31.1: na tāva bhaddāli idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho mahattaṃ patto hoti.
mn65:31.2: yato ca kho bhaddāli saṅgho mahattaṃ patto hoti atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti
mn65:31.3: atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:31.4: na tāva bhaddāli idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti yāva na saṅgho lābhaggaṃ patto hoti … yasaggaṃ patto hoti … bāhusaccaṃ patto hoti … rattaññutaṃ patto hoti.
mn65:31.5: yato ca kho bhaddāli saṅgho rattaññutaṃ patto hoti atha idhekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃyeva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
mn65:32.1: appakā kho tumhe bhaddāli tena samayena ahuvattha yadā vo ahaṃ ājānīyasusūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desesiṃ
mn65:32.5: so hi nūnāhaṃ bhante dīgharattaṃ satthu sāsane sikkhāya aparipūrakārī ahosinti.
mn65:32.6: na kho bhaddāli eseva hetu esa paccayo
mn65:32.7: apica me tvaṃ bhaddāli dīgharattaṃ cetasā ceto paricca vidito
mn65:32.8: navāyaṃ moghapuriso mayā dhamme desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇātīti
mn65:32.9: apica te ahaṃ bhaddāli ājānīyasusūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ desissāmi
mn65:32.11: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā bhaddāli bhagavato paccassosi.
mn65:33.1: seyyathāpi bhaddāli dakkho assadamako bhadraṃ assājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhameneva mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti.
mn65:33.2: tassa mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa hontiyeva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathātaṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa.
mn65:33.3: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.4: yato kho bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti tamenaṃ assadamako uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti yugādhāne.
mn65:33.5: tassa yugādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa hontiyeva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathātaṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa.
mn65:33.6: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.7: yato kho bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti tamenaṃ assadamako uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve varatthe rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.
mn65:33.8: tassa uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa hontiyeva visūkāyitāni visevitāni vipphanditāni kānici kānici yathātaṃ akāritapubbaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamānassa.
mn65:33.9: so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati.
mn65:33.10: yato kho bhaddāli bhadro assājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti tamenaṃ assadamako uttariṃ vaṇṇiyaṃ ca baliyaṃ ca anuppavecchati.
mn65:33.11: imehi kho bhaddāli dasahaṅgehi samannāgato bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati
mn65:34.1: evameva kho bhaddāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti
mn65:34.3: idha bhaddāli bhikkhu asekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti asekhena sammāsaṅkappena samannāgato hoti asekhāya sammāvācāya samannāgato hoti asekhena sammākammantena samannāgato hoti asekhena sammāājīvena samannāgato hoti asekhena sammāvāyāmena samannāgato hoti asekhāya sammāsatiyā samannāgato hoti asekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti asekhena sammāñāṇena samannāgato hoti asekhāya sammāvimuttiyā samannāgato hoti
mn65:34.4: imehi kho bhaddāli dasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
mn65:34.6: attamano āyasmā bhaddāli bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
